episodes.197232: By the 16th, moisture remained from a front that passed Puerto Rico and the U.S. |Virgin Islands, and was located southeast of them. A second front was approaching the area and brought additional rain late on the 16th and the 17th. In addition a surface trough and an upper level trough also helped increased flooding risk, and promoted unsettled weather conditions that will lead to flooding rains in several location across the area. Stations over southeast PR (the most affected) reported rainfall between 3-6 inches over that weekend. Several flooding and flash flooding events were reported, including one that sadly led to a fatality.

events.narrative: Flooding was reported in PR-31, Juncos, near the intersection with PR-9185. That sector of the road was closed due to it being impassable.
PR-52, exit 21, towards PR-172 were reported as flooded and impassable. This is near the Menonita Hospital in Caguas.
Areas near Hogar Cristo Rey in Ave. Degetou, were reported as flooded.
On PR-3, km 92.3, in Sector Aguacate from the old Winston Building to the old Union Carbide Building, a nearby river overflowed its banks and was blocking a passage through the road.
Rio Candelero, near sector Los Rodriguez in Bo. Candelero Arriba, Humacao was out of its banks and flooding nearby roads.
A landslide was blocking a lane on PR-908, km 10.5, in Jagueyes, Yabucoa.

Around 8:44 PM on November 16, 2024, a 63-year-old male and his passenger, a 39-year-old woman, crossed a low-level crossing/bridge in Barrio Guayabota, Sector Sasa, particularly on road 182 km 12. This bridge was covered with water as Guayanes River went over it due to the heavy rainfall activity that the municipality of Yabucoa was receiving. Radar estimates and observations suggested around 2 to 4 inches of rain in the area of the incident and around 6 inches across the municipality. As they crossed the bridge, the Ford F-150 that they were in got dragged into the fast-flowing river. During this event, the woman was trapped in the vehicle, that became lodged under rubble, and drowned.
The 911 Call Center reported a flooded house in El Cemi Public Housing, Building 4, Luquillo. This was Apartment 49 of that complex. No injuries nor fatalities were reported.
Debris flow was reported near El Cocotazo restaurant this afternoon at the intersection of PR-174, Los Sierra St., and Sect. La Charca in Aguas Buenas.
